goal: Relevant Google organic clicks to Hoopcut; page and candidate-query counts are inventory only

measurement.baseline_reason: No fresh authorized GSC Performance export obtained in this public-research implementation run. Indexing records are not click data.
measurement.query_segmentation: Inspect matching queries for the basketball app intent; separate ambiguous bare brand searches from software modifiers, and exclude the cleaning brand and NBA Street Homecourt game. Visible query totals exclude anonymized data.
measurement.page_segment: /homecourt and /homecourt/*; contextual updates reported as a separate cohort
measurement.windows: Matched completed 7-day and 28-day windows. Always disclose extraction time, date window, country and freshness; do not compare unequal launch exposure.
not_equivalent: App Store outbound clicks are not installs
a submitted sitemap is not indexation
time on page is not assumed to be a ranking signal
a keyword candidate is not measured demand

review_points.task: Check discoverability, crawlability and URL inspection; do not interpret lack of early clicks as a definitive content failure
Inspect actual queries, intent mismatch and early page-level impressions; avoid CTR claims on tiny samples
Review matched complete windows and choose improve, consolidate, investigate or expand by intent family

production_pipeline: Add or update source-backed demand record in pages.json; volume and KD remain null unless independently measured
Merge synonymous intents and map suitable demand to an existing page in existing-pages.json
Render all accepted records with the reusable generator; generated HTML is not the editing source
Run complete build, SEO validation and browser checks; package exact file hashes for review
Wait for approval of this batch before push, remote PR, merge, deployment or indexing submission
After approved deployment verification, record real release time and begin observation
stop_or_rework: No authoritative support for a factual claim: remove or defer it
Existing canonical page already answers the same intent: update it rather than add a synonym URL
Indexing failure: inspect the actual reason before adding pages
Indexed but no relevant impressions: reassess intent and competition before extending that family
Relevant impressions with weak ranking: identify missing evidence or functionality
Repeated relevant clicks: prioritize adjacent distinct needs without claiming guaranteed uplift

analytics.prepared_events: Existing tool_start/export_success hooks, only code-owned tool identifier and format; no entered costs or checklist contents
